notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
[p]The latest major update is now here! Try out all the new goodies:[/p][list][*][p][b]New level[/b]: Fight through a crystal-spiked snowstorm to ascend the Rhyom Summit[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Fighter skills[/b]: Use Rage Strike to build up huge damage, or disarm foes with Stagger[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Ranger skills[/b]: Use Smoke Bomb to escape, or unload your ammo with Blast Away[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Caster spells[/b]: Star Magic (Starfire and Supernova) and Crystal Magic (Clarity and Crystallize)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Cosmetics[/b]: Archon helmets are here, plus new “shifting” base metals[/p][/*][*][p][b]Video Recording[/b]: Click both thumbsticks and a camera will circle around to record your fight[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208683/fbd20b08086157d3c271c2efd93530d633684a14.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Miniboss Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*][b]Minibosses [/b]have arrived! Face new enemies like the gleeful bomb-tossing Jester, the poison dagger-throwing Assassin, and the life-stealing Vampire.
[*]Explore a [b]new cavern world[/b], Covenfel, featuring twisting underground passages full of luminescent crystals and dangerous enemies.
[*]Try out randomly-offered [b]Enhanced Skills[/b]: player upgrades with impressively boosted stats to enhance your build variety.
[*]New unlockable Permanent Upgrades, as well as new Challenge features to reward experienced players.
[*]Additional armor and helmet cosmetics, including the outfits worn by the new Miniboss enemies.
[*]And more!
[/list]
